design_system.theme: Cheerful field-guide editorial with a tactile farm-game personality
design_system.font_strategy: System-first sans serif for body copy with Arial Rounded MT Bold and Trebuchet MS fallbacks for friendly display headings; no external font dependency.
responsive_rules: Mobile at 375px uses a single-column hero, full-width CTAs, collapsible navigation, one-column cards, and simplified scene scale.
Tablet at 768px uses a single-column hero with two-column content cards where space permits and a non-sticky guide contents block.
Desktop at 1440px uses a 1160px content shell, two-column hero, four-column core loop, and sticky beginner-guide contents.
All tap targets are at least 44px high, page content does not rely on hover, and reduced-motion preferences disable animated transitions.

hero.headline: Build a smarter flock, one merge at a time.
hero.subheadline: Learn the buy-egg, earn-cash, and merge loop without wading through guesses. Follow a calm first-session route, then plan offline production and rebirth with confidence.

sections.title: Four moves that keep your farm growing
sections.purpose: Explain the buy, build, merge, collect, and reinvest rhythm in scan-friendly cards.

sections.title: Grow in layers, not in a rush
sections.purpose: Connect tutorial pads, the repeatable loop, offline production, Lucky Blocks, and cautious rebirth planning.

sections.title: Three shortcuts that usually create confusion
sections.purpose: Warn against skipping deposit, rushing rebirth, and trusting unverified or stale lists.

sections.title: Chicken Farm FAQ
sections.purpose: Answer five beginner questions while routing readers back to the internal tutorial.

sections.title: Ready to hatch your first plan?
sections.purpose: Close with a second natural internal link to the beginner guide.

page_map.purpose: SEO-led homepage and visual overview of the core loop, progression route, common mistakes, and FAQ.
Interactive five-step first-session checklist with persistent device-local progress and supporting tips.

assets.description: Farm scene, egg mark, background pattern, and decorative shapes are built entirely with candidate-authored CSS; no third-party image files are used.
Unicode emoji are used as small illustrative labels in the core-loop cards.

excluded_claims: Complete rebirth table or exact rebirth costs
Any evergreen promise based on mutable Update 7 details
copy_guardrails: Use the in-game reset summary as the source of current rebirth effects and costs.
Describe approved mechanics without inventing exact rates, prices, timers, or tier names.
Keep mutable-game disclaimers visible on both pages.

keyboard_support: Native details and summary FAQ controls
